title: Pre- and post-dam river water temperature alteration prediction using advanced machine learning models.
summary: The original full text supports the bounded AI-enabled finding: ML models estimate daily water temperature at Yangtze River Cuntan before/after dam construction; the study-specific output addresses measured hydrologic temperature alteration at that site.
